name: instant-worker — entitlement drift outpacing regrade (30m) [upgrades landing team row before infra cap]
description: Fires when the entitlement_reconciler is DETECTING more drifted Postgres resources than it is successfully RE-GRADING over a rolling window — i.e. drift is accumulating faster than the fix lands. instant_entitlement_drift_detected_total counts postgres resources found with a connection cap that no longer matches their team's plan tier (the F6 partial-upgrade symptom: the team row flipped to the paid tier but the backend cap did not follow). instant_entitlement_regraded_total counts the resources the reconciler then successfully brought up to the entitled value (provisioner returned applied=true). In steady state every detected drift is regraded on the same sweep, so detected ≈ regraded. When detected sustainedly EXCEEDS regraded, paying customers are stuck on lower-tier backend limits and the reconciler can't keep up (gRPC errors / provisioner skips — see the companion entitlement-regrade-failed alert). P1: user-visible, recoverable. Source: worker/internal/jobs/entitlement_reconciler.go; both counters in worker/internal/metrics/metrics.go (EntitlementDriftDetectedTotal, EntitlementRegradedTotal).

nrql.query: SELECT sum(instant_entitlement_drift_detected_total) - sum(instant_entitlement_regraded_total) FROM Metric WHERE service = 'worker'
